name: review-changes
description: Use when the user asks to "review my changes", "review the working tree", "review uncommitted code", or invokes /review-changes, or when feature-dev hands off after implementation. Read-only analyst over the UNCOMMITTED working-tree changes (like pr-review, but nothing is committed yet), reporting findings tagged Blocker/Major/Minor/Nit and ending with a loop-control verdict on whether feature-dev should re-plan and fix. Writes nothing.
